[Verse 1]
Piston and paper, a ledger of sparks
Arc welder's hymn for the factory dark
Conveyor of reasons, the spare part of grace
Numbers arrive and dissolve in the chase

[Verse 2]
A torque wrench serenade in the orange glow
Every bolt a small rehearsal
The floor plans dream in graphite shadow
While the mill relays the morning
